sentences.la: Fabrī tam miserī sunt ut nōn cantent.
sentences.en: The craftsmen are so unhappy that they do not sing.

sentences.la: Uxor tam fessa est ut statim dormiat.
sentences.en: The wife is so tired that she sleeps at once.

sentences.la: Coniūnx tam miser est ut maereat.
sentences.en: The spouse is so unhappy that he grieves.

sentences.la: Rēx tam saevus est ut incolae taceant.
sentences.en: The king is so savage that the inhabitants are silent.

sentences.la: Tantus est timor ut fēminae tremant.
sentences.en: So great is the fear that the women tremble.

sentences.la: Ita clāmat eques ut omnēs veniant.
sentences.en: The horseman shouts in such a way that all come.

sentences.la: Coniūnx tam celeriter currit ut nēmō eum audiat.
sentences.en: The spouse runs so quickly that nobody hears him.

sentences.la: Frāter tam aeger est ut nōn ambulet.
sentences.en: The brother is so sick that he does not walk.

sentences.la: Syra tam fessa erat ut statim dormīret.
sentences.en: Syra was so tired that she slept at once.
